title: Early-Payment Credit on the Maternity Pre-Delivery Balance (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
Credit term of the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery under Good Faith & Price Estimates for a pre-delivery balance paid well ahead of the expected delivery date.

**Term.** The days to delivery run from today's date to the expected delivery date, today not counted and the delivery date counted. Sixty or more days to delivery take off two percent (2 percent) of the delivery package price; thirty-five to fifty-nine days take off one percent (1 percent); fewer than thirty-five days, a passed expected delivery date included, take off nothing. The delivery package price is the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the principal service code on the current version.

| Days to delivery | Credit taken off |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 2 percent of the delivery package price |
| 35 to 59 | 1 percent of the delivery package price |
| 0 to 34, or a passed expected delivery date | nothing |

Edges (hypothetical, delivery package price 10000.00): 60 days, 200.00 off; 59 days, 100.00 off; 35 days, 100.00 off; 34 days, nothing.
